theme.title: Top 8: The Person You Watched Into Being

figure.name: Howdy Doody
figure.breakdown: The first television character a generation answered by name, shouting a chant back at the screen every afternoon for thirteen years while the voice came off a recording. The tie was engineered down to the theme song, and the puppets were sold as toys, which moved it into the children's own hands.
figure.why_today: Today's edition: The Person You Watched, set by “Reality star arrested after brawl leaves teen dead”. This figure is the record's case for it.

source.title: Reality star arrested after brawl leaves teen dead

figure.tell: Buffalo Bob Smith first performed Howdy Doody as a radio voice; Frank Paris built a puppet to match it; when Paris left in 1948 over merchandising rights he took the original puppet with him and the replacement debuted that June.

divine.title: Am I not here, I who am your mother?
divine.why: Addressed, never met: nobody in the record meets her, and the other end is understood to hear - the founding sentence of the devotion is her answer to a worried man.

institution.title: The audience organised against the show
institution.why: Filed institution/fandom-body, on the shelf's test: "Does the group have rules that are not the platform's, and can it act on somebody who is not a member?" The audience that loved the show built its own machinery - a six-month newspaper campaign.

cosmology.title: The Neighbours finale broke something in the schedule
cosmology.why: Not just grief: the shape of a whole country's week rearranged around a soap ending. The clearest documented case that the slot can matter more than the thing in it.

officer.title: The craft of the sage Adapa
officer.why: A sage whose teaching reaches a reader intact and whose person never does - standing without a role and without a meeting. The same gap that produced this shelf for the Greek erastes produces it again here, two centuries earlier and in writing rather than in life.

predator.title: Fighting about a stranger in a reply section
predator.why: Fighting about a stranger in a reply section, in good faith. The object is a non-person who cannot be fought with, and the mechanism is the in-group. This is the cleanest instance of the register-as-category confusion the old taxonomy suffered from.
